raw_translation: Siffofin fuska suna cikin nau'ikan salo na ba-da-ido ba, ba kuma bayanai na likita ko na asalin ba. Hanyar gwajin da bambancin halitta na iya canza sakamakon; bambance-bambancen da aka haɗe ba za su dace da wani nau'i guda ba. Kayan aiki na amfani da adadin da ka shigar kawai kuma ba ya samun damar kamara ko adana gwajin.
source: Face-shape labels are informal style categories, not medical or identity information. Measurement technique and natural variation can change the result; mixed proportions may not fit a single category. The tool uses only numbers you enter and does not access a camera or store measurements.
